experiment: C -- a data-movement schedule for the A/B exchange
kickmix_role: local rebuild with MR and per-instruction execution counts (scripts/build_kickmix_mr.py); not the pinned competition binary

prediction.question: can a data-movement schedule resolve the A/B exchange at build time, so that the emitted circuit is smaller rather than the executed one?
prediction.why_it_matters: a saving from a *read* needs `mr`; a saving from a *schedule* is in the emitted circuit, so it survives the pinned competition binary (see Experiment D)

C1_rebased.change: do not exchange (n_A, n_a, reg_a) with (n_B, n_b, reg_b); reassign which physical register plays the A role in each round from the round index alone, and hand the Forney block the register holding role B
C1_rebased.assumption: the sub-step counter advances once per live round, so `c3` fires in rounds with i % 4 == 3 and the role assignment is a function of the round index
C1_rebased.why_exactly: the arm removes the region, so the saving is the region's whole executed cost, including the two control ANDs inside it
C1_rebased.predicted_correct_if_and_only_if: the c3-round set is the same for every shot
C1_rebased.falsifier: this arm itself: if it is incorrect, the schedule is data-dependent and no build-time resolution exists

C2_pattern.method: read the c3 control into a per-round qubit of a probe arm and compare the patterns across the 64 shots
C2_pattern.prediction: the pattern is a function of the shot's syndrome, so distinct patterns > 1 and C1 is unavailable; one pattern would make C1 exact

C3_flag_redundant.change: exchange on `c3` alone instead of `c3 and flag`, dropping the control AND pair (the campaign's S3b arm showed the shift's not-flag-and-c3 branch is dead in every c3 round)

campaign_arm_audit.why: the campaign's `_shift_a_and_b` is never called: the reference and `MRGatedDecoder` call `_shift_b_array_right`, so both arms emit the control's instruction stream -- until it is renamed, which is what `campaign_composed` / `campaign_drop_c3` measure

c3_only_prediction.outcome: falsified: the flag operand is not redundant in a c3 round

checks.check: the control arm reproduces the five-gate incumbent
checks.requirement: 686014.8 executed Toffolis per shot at Q=1913

checks.check: the control arm's exchange row reproduces the campaign's
the campaign's two zero-saving arms are audited, not assumed
checks.requirement: the emitted streams are compared with the control's

checks.check: the campaign's `composed` arm is an arm now
checks.requirement: its instruction stream differs from the same decoder without the gate (the campaign could not show that: the method carrying the gate was never called)

checks.check: the campaign's `drop_shift_c3` arm is an arm now
checks.requirement: its instruction stream differs from the same decoder without the gate (the campaign could not show that: the method carrying the gate was never called)

checks.check: C1: resolving the exchange at build time removes the region
checks.requirement: the swap row falls to 0.0 and the arm's static count falls by 198024 (the region's whole static cost, control ANDs included)

checks.check: C1: the rebased arm is correct only if the schedule is a function of the round index
checks.requirement: recorded, not assumed: this arm is the falsifier of its own hypothesis, so its total is not evidence either way

checks.check: C3: the flag-only arm was built and measured
checks.requirement: an arm that exchanges on c3 alone, correct or not

checks.check: C3: the exchange's two operands are read where it reads them
checks.requirement: `c3` and the post-update `flag` per round per shot, so that `c3 and flag` can be compared with `c3` alone

checks.check: C2: the movement schedule's predicate set is measured per shot
checks.requirement: a pattern per shot, and the count of distinct ones

verdict: the schedule is data-dependent: no build-time resolution exists

scope.measured: a correct, cheaper-or-not arm per variant at the pinned instance, with the executed instruction stream and read count beside every Toffoli figure
scope.not_measured: no receipt: the incumbent's reads still need `mr`, which the pinned competition binary does not have (Experiment D)
